svg.title: PiPER Active-View Scanning: Detailed System Architecture
svg.desc: One command path, accepted-only evidence, and explicit feedback from request to reconstruction
svg.text: PiPER Active-View Scanning: Detailed System Architecture
One command path, accepted-only evidence, and explicit feedback from request to reconstruction

g.text: External task ownership; the tracked base is never commanded here.
Admission, process generations and terminal lifecycle remain correlated.
3 Produce measured target and scene evidence
Timestamped RGB-D, calibration and isolated AI feed ROS safety evidence.
4 Select the next useful and feasible view
Accepted captures alone change measured coverage.
5 Propose motion through one frozen backend
Both backends are integrated; cuRobo remains hardware-unqualified.
6 Authorize and execute through one command owner
All planner backends traverse the same fail-closed physical boundary.
7 Admit or reject the settled observation
Acceptance, retry and rejection deliberately have different feedback effects.
8 Recover safely, correlate base home and reconstruct
Offline reconstruction consumes immutable evidence after the required safe state.

text.tspan: validated before admission; immutable in flight
canonical mission SHA-256 binds every downstream result
queues and admits one immutable goal
binds task, target and backend identity
prove all-six disable and revoke authorization
motor-authority loss permits no new command
settled capture uses new synchronized frames
fault may restart only owned vision work
complete or exhaust the safe frontier
target-facing aim with bounded orientation fallback
shortlist at most 12 voxel points or 6 ray directions
no motor command is possible at this stage
freezes tesseract or curobo for the mission
requires matching worker generation and readiness
snapshots joints, limits, target, camera and scene
binds robot/world/calibration hashes and requested views
publishes correlated status, blockers and provenance
ROS-free exact IK, collision and path
backend, request, plan and trajectory hashes
planner output remains a proposal only
six finite joints in canonical order
following error, timeout and settle proof
matching achieved FK and plan provenance
hold achieved FK; add no coverage
then exclude and replan from actual pose
disable all six and revoke authorization
arm result may wait for base home
bind task, job and manifest identity
this repository sends no chassis command
admit immutable inputs and verify every hash
target-only Open3D TSDF; 3 mm voxels by default
optional bounded GICP / scene pose graph
failure is separate and never rewrites mission safety

g.text: Red is the sole motor-command edge. Dashed green paths are measured feedback, retry or replanning.
